To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
local financial development has positive effects on firm productivity, which are stronger when the social environment is sufficiently developed.
the positive effects on productivity of greater local financial development are stronger when the local socio-institutional context is sufficiently developed.
local financial development has a significant effect on firm productivity in Italy, and the effect is stronger when the socioinstitutional environment is more developed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of local development on firm productivity and the role of financial development in this context.
the interaction of two types of development: financial and socio-institu-tional, and it shows that they can reinforce each other in promoting productivity.
the effects of financial and socio-institu-tional environments on productivity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effects of local socio-institutional environments on productivity are conditional on the degree of local financial development.
local financial development, socio-institutional factors, and firm productivity are positively and significantly correlated.
the effects of local banking development on firm productivity are not only positive but also conditional on the quality and strength of the socio-institutions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
local financial development is a necessary, but not sufficient, condition to improve productivity.
the quality of the institutional environment is a necessary condition for financial development to have positive real effects on productivity.
local financial development and the quality of the local socio-institutional context are complements, rather than substitutes, for enhancing the productivity of firms.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the real effects from the development of financial and socio-institutions are conditional on each other.
local financial development and local social capital are complementary factors that jointly affect productivity.
financial and institutional development should be pursued jointly.
